summary: A quarter of veterans have a civilian job lined up before they leave service, and about half start looking right away.
realLife: Pew found 25 percent had a job lined up, 48 percent searched immediately and 21 percent searched after a delay. Among post-9/11 veterans without a job, 57 percent found one within six months.
sources: Pew Research Center, The transition to post-military employment (2019): https://www.pewresearch.org/social-trends/2019/09/10/the-transition-to-post-military-employment/
